description: This Java class 'ThingSearchJsonExamplesProducer' generates example JSON files related to search commands and responses for testing or demonstration purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ThingSearchJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that produces example JSON files for search commands and responses, mainly for testing or documentation purposes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that initiates the production of example JSONs by calling produceSudoCommands with the provided directory path.

methods.name: produceSudoCommands
methods.description: Generates various predefined command and response examples, serializes them to JSON, and saves them to files within the specified root directory.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Helper method that writes a JSON string to a specified file path and prints a message indicating the file write operation.
